title: Malicious Owner Can Mint Wrapped BTC From Arbitrary Bitcoin Transactions
summary: This bug report discusses an issue with the PEG-IN functionality of the bridge server. The bug allows the owner of the server to mint an unlimited amount of wrapped BTC to a random address, potentially causing significant damage. The suggested solution is to implement a mechanism to verify the transaction's destination on Bitcoin, ensuring it is the correct address generated by the server. The bug has been resolved in a recent update, but it is important to note that the new cryptographic library used has not been audited.
